reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the coherent nanoprecipitate strengthening strategy from high-entropy soft magnets (P7, P14, P17, P24) to MnNiSi-based magnetocaloric alloys (P1, P3), but the mechanism and predicted outcome are taken almost word-for-word from the soft magnet literature without adapting them to the first-order magnetostructural transition or addressing the known brittleness of these alloys. The core idea is a straightforward application of an existing concept to a new material class, with no new mechanistic insight or integration of the conflicting requirements of a magnetostructural transformation.
